name: createExtraCurricularActivityType
description: Creates a new Extra Curricular Activity Type record with a specified name and category assignment.
taskName: Creating New Extra Curricular Activity Type Record

basic.name: createExtraCurricularActivityType
basic.description: Creates a new Extra Curricular Activity Type record with a specified name and category assignment.

args.name: typeName
args.description: The name of the activity type to create (e.g., "Theatre / Drama / Stage performances"). Maximum 120 characters.

args.name: categoryCode
args.description: The code of the category to assign (e.g., "000003" for "Arts / Creative"). Either categoryCode or categoryName must be provided.

args.name: categoryName
args.description: The name of the category to assign (e.g., "Arts / Creative"). Either categoryCode or categoryName must be provided.
